guard/30200.htm.text: Guard Stan: Are you going to Hunters Village, my friend? Then follow this path towards the southern plain, you will end up at a forked road, go east from there. I heard that place is a very exciting...

links.text: View the information about the lord and the tax rate of the manor.

guard/30200-1.htm.text: Guard Stan: Have you heard, that there is the Enchanted Valley, east of our town? You can capture various creatures there. That is why Hunters made a little village there, but some of the Hunters had other jobs besides being Hunters. Well, people with various backgrounds with various jobs live ther…

Q00192_SevenSignsSeriesOfDoubt/30200-01..text: Guard Stan: ARGH! What are you playing at? There's something sneaking round the castle, people are going missing, everyone's on edge, and you still think the best idea is to sneak up on old Stan and scare the stuffing out of him?! What's wrong with you? And what do you want?

links.text: "Hector sent me. I'm here about the thing you saw."

Q00192_SevenSignsSeriesOfDoubt/30200-05..text: Guard Stan: You still have questions for me? I told you everything I know. The thing I saw that night was in the area east of Oren Castle . Unless you have something else to ask me, you better get going--I'll be back on duty soon....

Q00252_ItSmellsDelicious/30200-01.htm.text: Guard Stan: Smell that? Sweet salvation, that's what it smells like to me. Like a juicy slice of heaven, wrapped in honey by angels and turned into an aroma. Hm... I smell it every Thursday. Sadly, I've never tasted it. A lesser man would have gone mad by now. MAD I say!! I don't know what it is, b…

links.text: Ask about the Sel Mahum Training Grounds.

Q00252_ItSmellsDelicious/30200-02.htm.text: Guard Stan: Hmm... I don't think you have the nose to track down this delicious smell for me. (Only characters level 82 or above can take this quest.)

Q00252_ItSmellsDelicious/30200-06.html.text: Guard Stan: Did you find it?! But I'm starving!! Man, I am THIS close to abandoning my post and gobbling whatever is making that smell. Just find it and bring it here, please!! I haven't eaten all day and it smells y-u-m-m-m-y!!

Q00252_ItSmellsDelicious/30200-07.html.text: Guard Stan: Well?! I'm dying here! Smells so good! I should've eaten breakfast but I slept in. Let me see what you found. Hm these recipe notes are torn, they're hard to read. Maybe if I hm AHA! Salmon soup? That smell was from salmon soup? Hey, help me put these pieces together. I will learn this …
when: state STARTED; cond 2; hasItemsAtLimit(qs.getPlayer(), DIARY, COOKBOOK_PAGE)

Q00252_ItSmellsDelicious/30200-03.html.text: Guard Stan: My love affair with salmon soup is all because of you. And so is this incremental weight gain in my thighs and midsection. But still, thanks! (You have already completed this quest.)

Q00289_NoMoreSoupForYou/30200-01.htm.text: Guard Stan: Hello my friend, we need you help right now. What do yuo think?

Q00289_NoMoreSoupForYou/30200-00.htm.text: Guard Stan: Hello, my friend. We go way back, it is true. We've laughed, we've cried. I told you about my wife, and how she has long toenails. But I can't ask you for any favors right now. (Only characters level 82 or above who have completed It Smells Delicious can take this quest.)

Q00289_NoMoreSoupForYou/30200-04.htm.text: Guard Stan: Oh you returned? Choose what you want.

links.text: Exchange 500 items for a weapon recipe/material.
Exchange 100 items for a armor or jewelery recipe/material.

Q00289_NoMoreSoupForYou/30200-03.htm.text: Guard Stan: I'll need at least 100 of Full Barrels of Soup . But, if you bring more, I can offer more and greater rewards. The more, the better.

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30165-01.html.text: Trader Ralford: Isn't magic wonderful? It transformed this humble item into such an incredibly beautiful object! Although I am but a simple trader, I am overwhelmed by its sublime loveliness... So, what would you like to trade it for? These are the only coins I have... If you wish to trade with me …

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30200-01.html.text: Guard Stan: Do you know what a numismatist is, pal? Some old fella came by a couple of days ago and called me one, and just as I was gearing up to knock him flat on his back, he says it was a term used for someone who collected coins. Looked it up, and he was only right, wasn't he? Stan the Numisma…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30688-01.html.text: Blacksmith Duning: I've created many beautiful objects in my career, but never have I seen anything so magnificent! This could not have ?been created by the hands of a mere mortal! I feel that some magic has been infused into it. What do you wish to exchange? You have nothing but this coin. To trad…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30165-54.html.text: Trader Ralford: I am but a second level member and am not allowed to trade with you... You should seek Magister Paige of Hunters Village, Researcher Lorain near the Cruma Tower or Warehouse Keeper Hagger in the Town of Oren. They all will trade with a level 3 member.

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30200-54.html.text: Guard Stan: I'm only a second level member, pal, so can't deal with you. You want to find Magister Paige, Researcher Lorain or Warehouse Keeper Hagger though - they'll be more than happy to trade with a level 3 member like yourself.

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30688-54.html.text: Blacksmith Duning: I cannot trade with higher-level members than myself. You are level 3 and should go and find Magister Page of Hunter's Village, Investigator Lorraine near Cruma Tower or Warehouse Keeper Hagger of the Town of Oren.

Q00461_RumbleInTheBase/30200-01.htm.text: Guard Stan: You've seen Sel Mahums train? It's impressive, isn't it. Pinaps fears they are becoming too powerful. He doesn't know what to do. But I do...

Q00461_RumbleInTheBase/30200-02.htm.text: Guard Stan: Have you talked to Pinaps? He's worried about all the training going on at the Sel Mahum's camp. If he'd only ask me, I'd tell him how to solve it. But the ideas and opinions of guards are often overlooked, such is life. (Only character level 82 or above who have completed It Smells Del…

Q00461_RumbleInTheBase/30200-06.html.text: Guard Stan: What is it? Pinaps is over there. See the face he's making? That means he is thinking real hard, or he forgot what he was doing.

Q00461_RumbleInTheBase/30200-07.html.text: Guard Stan: Thank you! I'll certainly tell Pinaps about you. That's what friends are for, right? That was fun. We could stop Sel Mahums from training everyday! Okay, I'm getting hungry... time for soup.

Q00461_RumbleInTheBase/30200-03.htm.text: Guard Stan: Thanks for your hard work. Today Pinaps doesn't have to worry anymore. Worrying just shaves time off your life, makes you wrinkly, and causes gas. A true friend will put up with all that to help take some of the stress away. True friends also bring salmon soup. (You can take on this que…

Q00192_SevenSignsSeriesOfDoubt/30200-02..text: Guard Stan: Ha, did Hector tell you to be that vague, too? He's jumpier than a cat in a thunderstorm these days, looking for things that ain't there, and jamming two coincidences together to make conspiracies. Yeah, maybe I saw something, and maybe it was a bit odd. Maybe I felt a pervading sense o…

links.text: "Well, no actually. What exactly did you see?"

Q00192_SevenSignsSeriesOfDoubt/30200-03..text: Guard Stan: I was out walking through the Oren Castle grounds a couple of nights ago. Truth be told, I was clearing my head - women problems, see? Anyway, there I was, when a chill creeps up my spine and everything goes deathly quiet. Suddenly this thing appears in front of me, makes some weird old…

links.text: "If you say so. Where was this exactly?"

Q00192_SevenSignsSeriesOfDoubt/30200-04..text: Guard Stan: Why? You're not... you're not thinking of going there are you? But there's nothing there... and if there WAS something there then it's not something you'll want to sit down and share stories with, trust me. Anyway, the area East of Oren Castle is fairly unspectacular. Nothing there you'…

Q00252_ItSmellsDelicious/30200-04.htm.text: Guard Stan: What? Oh, sorry. It's just... Someone cooked something and it smells REALLY good. But yes, we called it Skyshadow Meadow until the Sel Mahums started using it for battle training. Gave it some goofy name... Sel Mahum Training Grounds I think. Should have named it 'What the hell is that …

Q00252_ItSmellsDelicious/30200-05.htm.text: Guard Stan: As I expected, they're cooking the dish over their campfires. The soup will soon be mine! Search their pockets for the recipe. I think the Sel Mahum Squad Leaders might keep it with them. They tend to hang around the campfires gobbling up soup. The Sel Mahum Chef is another possibility.…

Q00252_ItSmellsDelicious/30200-08.html.text: Guard Stan: 'I LOVE SALMON SOUP!' 'Man, warms you right up! I need a napkin.. Nah I'll just lick my face!' 'Salmon soup.. Hmm... my newest favorite of everything...' 'Oohh, I don't feel so good. That campfire is making me nauseous...' Well, it looks like Sel Mahum Squad Leaders are so busy eating s…

Q00289_NoMoreSoupForYou/30200-02.htm.text: Guard Stan: Pinaps thinks that Soup makes Sel Mahums more powerfull! You should steal their food!

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30200-02.html.text: Guard Stan: A Gold Giant eh? All right, I'll give you one Gold Giant for five Gold Drakes and... five Gold Knights. OR you can try your luck and try a game of chance for a better deal.

links.text: "Let's play that game of yours." [Guess correctly in two tries - 3 Gold Knights]
"Let's play that game of yours." [Guess correctly in three tries - 7 Gold Knights]
"Let's play that game of yours." [Guess correctly in four tries - 9 Gold Knights]

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30200-03.html.text: Guard Stan: Ah, the Blood Basilisk! Haven't given one of them out in... ooh... hours. Okay, I'll give you one Blood Basilisk for five Blood Werewolves and five Blood Drevanuls. Or you can try your luck in a game of chance?

links.text: "I'll just take the standard rate, thanks."
"Let's play." [Guess correctly in two tries - 3 blood werewolves]
"Let's play." [Guess correctly in three tries - 7 blood werewolves]
"Let's play." [Guess correctly in four tries - 9 blood werewolves]

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30200-04.html.text: Guard Stan: Want a Silver Dryad, eh?How's this: I'll give you one Silver Dryad in exchange for five Silver Fairies and five Silver Golems. Or we can play a game and you might win better odds? Up to you.

links.text: "Let's play." [Guess correctly in two tries - 3 silver fairies]
"Let's play." [Guess correctly in three tries - 7 silver fairies]
"Let's play." [Guess correctly in four tries - 9 silver fairies]

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30200-05.html.text: Guard Stan: You want a Manak's Silver Dryad. Hmm... haven't got many left, but I'll give you one for ten Silver Fairies and ten Silver Golems. Or we can play a game of chance?

links.text: "Let's play your game." [Guess correctly in two tries - 3 silver fairies and 3 Silver Golems]
"Let's play your game." [Guess correctly in three tries - 7 silver fairies and 7 Silver Golems]
"Let's play your game." [Guess correctly in four tries - 9 silver fairies and 9 Silver Golems]

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30200-06.html.text: Guard Stan: And how many would you like to trade exactly?

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30200-07.html.text: Guard Stan: Here you go then! On your way now, before people start thinking I'm taking bribes again. Which I'm not, mostly.

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30200-10.html.text: Guard Stan: Sorry pal, but you don't have anything I'm interested in. Come back when you've got the coins I want, all right? Now run along before before start whispering!

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30200-51.html.text: Guard Stan: Two correct answers! So close! Go on... have another go. What's the color of the first coin?

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30200-52.html.text: Guard Stan: Impressive! It takes a whole heap of dedication and practice to be 100% wrong! Go on... try again. What's the color of the first coin?

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30200-53.html.text: Guard Stan: Well, it's a game where you have to guess the colours of three coins I have on me. I know, I know... not the greatest game in the world, but these are long hours, and I have to keep myself entertained, you know?

Q00461_RumbleInTheBase/30200-04.htm.text: Guard Stan: Strength in battle comes from your stomach. Big swords, lots of training, all worthless compared to a belly fully of good food. Hey, can you tell Pinaps not to worry about me? That would be swell.

Q00461_RumbleInTheBase/30200-05.htm.text: Guard Stan: I've pretty much established at this point that the Sel Mahum draw their fierce power in battle from their delicious Salmon Soup. I cannot allow this. Take salmon from the Sel Mahum Chefs , so that Sel Mahums will know the suffering of life without tasty salmon soup! Then remove the sho…
